title: Define untrusted content source-to-sink policy
purpose: Prevent external webpages, documents, API responses, and tool observations from directly driving dangerous tools.
scope: Define source labels for operator input, local system output, external untrusted content, model output, and sanitized summary.
Define sink classes for read-only, write-with-diff, execute-with-confirmation, privileged, network egress, and secret access.
Implement policy checks that block untrusted source content from directly triggering high-risk sinks.
Require sanitize/summarize/classify before untrusted content can influence replanning.
Audit denied source-to-sink attempts with reason and source label.
Add fixtures for webpages that instruct the agent to run commands or exfiltrate data.
acceptance_criteria: Untrusted text cannot directly create execute, privileged, network exfiltration, or secret-use actions.
Sanitized summaries retain source labels and do not erase trust boundaries.
Denied source-to-sink attempts are audited without EffectPrepared.
Operator-approved actions still require exact approval token binding.
verification: Inspect denied audit records for source label and sink class.
Confirm no high-risk EffectPrepared exists for untrusted content fixtures.
risk_notes: This is the primary guard against prompt injection becoming OS-level action.
implementation_steps: Define source labels for operator, local-system, sandboxed tool, external, model, memory, audit-derived, and sanitized content.
Define sink classes for read, write, execute, privileged, network, and secret access.
Deny model, external, or untrusted direct access to execute, privileged, secret, and exfiltration-capable network sinks.
Allow sanitized summaries to inform planning without granting authority.
Preserve source labels through sanitization and replanning hints.
Audit denied source-to-sink attempts without EffectPrepared.
failure_modes: Webpage text triggers command execution or package install.
Model-origin content reads secrets or posts data.
Sanitization erases trust boundary or grants authority.
Denied source-to-sink attempt prepares an effect.
Audit projection cannot explain source and sink class.

verification_matrix.expected: external content cannot prepare shell, exfiltration, login-download, or policy-override effects
source labels, sink classes, denied paths, and sanitized summaries behave as specified
source-to-sink checks do not break legitimate operator-approved paths

blocked_until: Untrusted content cannot drive high-risk sinks.
